title: WHAT IS THE POLITICAL CONTENT IN LLMS’ PRE AND POST-TRAINING DATA?

bias_targets.methodology: Classifying pre- and post-training documents as left-leaning, right-leaning, or neutral using an LLM-based zero-shot classifier, and correlating the predominant political stances in the training data with the model's generated stances on eight specific policy issues using the ProbVAA dataset.
